chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from one of our companions, from Ali ibn Sulayman ibn Rushayd, from Musa ibn, from Musa ibn Sallam, from Sa'dan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said to him, 'What is that which establishes faith in the servant?' He said, 'Piety (restraint).' And what is that which removes it from him?' He said, 'Greed.'
ai.seo_question: What establishes and removes faith in a servant according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a direct causal link between spiritual restraint (al-wara') and the stability of faith, while identifying greed (al-tama') as the corrosive force that expels it. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on 'wara'' not merely as caution, but as an active guarding of the heart against worldly attachments that distract from divine remembrance. The pairing highlights how internal disposition dictates the permanence of one's spiritual state.
